On an open chain set $H_L=\sum_{j=1}^{L-1}h_{j,j+1}$; on a ring set $H_L=\sum_{j\in\mathbb Z/L\mathbb Z}h_{j,j+1}$ with periodic indices. For an open chain define the absent boundary currents $j_{0,1}=j_{L,L+1}=0$. Use $\hbar>0$ in joule-seconds. These finite local data may be realized on a tensor-product spin space or on a finite fixed-particle site space, provided.
